items: At pH around 6-7.5, HOCl predominates and makes the disinfection process more effective.
At higher pH (above 7.5), OCl⁻ predominates, its less effective but still provides disinfection.

blocks.text: The higher the amount of chlorine, the more effective the disinfection. Sufficient chlorine must be added to get enough HOCl and OCl⁻ to kill bacteria.
Contact time of water with chlorine must be long enough, to allow the disinfectants to penetrate and kill bacteria, viruses and protozoa.

blocks.title: Quick Check 13.6
blocks.text:
a) Why HOCl is more effective disinfectant than OCl⁻ to kill bacteria in water?
b) What are the factors that affect disinfection of bacteria in water?
c) What are the primary active species in the chlorination of water? Give equation that shows their production.
